question:

Which of the following years has the highest rate of increase compared to the previous year
solution:
**Given:**

Data regarding the population of a city at the end of the years mentioned.

**Formula used:**

Rate of increase = (population in current year - population in previous year) / (population in previous year) × 100

**Calculation:**

The rate of increase for a given year compared to the previous year can be calculated by using above formula.

Lets calculate the rate of increase for a given year compared to the previous year, 

Rate of increase in 2013 = (68.4-64.5)/(64.5)times 100 = 6.04

Rate of increase in 2014 = (72.6-68.4)/(68.4)times 100 = 10.93

Rate of increase in 2015 = (83.8-72.6)/(72.6)times 100 = 15.42

Rate of increase in 2016 = (100.6-83.8)/(83.8)times 100 = 20.4

Rate of increase in 2017 = (112.8-100.6)/(100.6)times 100 = 12.12

Rate of increase in 2018 = (128.4-112.8)/(112.8)times 100 = 13.8

Rate of increase in 2019 = (134.6-128.4)/(128.4)times 100 = 4.82

Rate of increase in 2020 = (156.8-134.6)/(134.6)times 100 = 16.49

Rate of increase in 2021 = (176.4-156.8)/(156.8)times 100 = 12.5

**2016 has ****the highest rate of increase compared to the previous year which is 20.4%**
